spans.s: दल् vi. or vt. 1P (pp. दलित) 1. To burst open, to split, to crack, दलति हृदयं गाढोद्वेगं द्विधा तु न भिद्यते M.M.ix., दलति न सा हृदि विरहभरेण Git.G.vii., Am.
; 2. to expand, to open (as a flower), अयि दलदरविंद Bh.V.i.5, 15.With वि-, 1. to break, to split, to crack, Na.iv.88; 2. to dig.
दल् Caus. (दलयति-दालयति) 1. to tear asunder; 2. to cut, to divide.

दल m.n. 1. A piece, a portion, a fragment, Sis.iv.44; 2. a degree; 3. a half, the half; 4. a sheath, a scabbard; 5. a petal, a leaf, R.iv.42; 6. the blade of any weapon; 7. a lump, a heap, a quantity; 8. a detachment, a body of men.
दल-आढक m. 1. foam; 2. a moat, a ditch; 3. a hurricane, a high wind; 4. red chalk.
दल-कोष m. the kunda creeper.
दल-निर्मोक m. the bhūrja tree.
दल-पुष्पा f. the ketaka plant.
दल-शस् ind. in pieces or fragments.
दल-सूचि, -सूची f. a thorn.
दल-सूचि, -सूची f. a thorn.
दल-स्नसा f. the fibre or vein of a leaf.
दलन n. Bursting, breaking, crushing, grinding, मत्तेभकुंभदलने भुवि संति शूराः Bhartr.i.59.
दलप m. 1. A weapon; 2. gold.
दलनी f. A clod of earth.
दलि m.f. A clod of earth.
दलित a. (f. ता) 1. Broken, burst, split; 2. opend, expanded, (pp. of दल् q.v.).
दलित a. (f. ता) 1. Broken, burst, split; 2. opend, expanded, (pp. of दल् q.v.).
दल्भ m. 1. A wheel; 2. fraud, dishonesty.
दाडि(लि)म (I) m.f. 1. The pomegranate tree, करोति दाडिमफलव्याजेन वाग्बंधनम् Am.
; 2. small cardamoms.
दाडि(लि)म (II) n. The fruit of the pomegranate tree.
दाडि(लि)म-प्रिय, -भक्षण m. a parrot.
दाडि(लि)म-प्रिय, -भक्षण m. a parrot.
दाल्मि m. A name of Indra.
